g.text: Conversational brain — the production pipeline + the region inventory
TOP: the production conversation (OneBrainComposer) — comprehend → bind into a fact → recall & answer (with the no–confabulation safeguard) → reply
BELOW: the underlying region inventory built by build_biological_brain_regions() (a reference) · concept pools collapsed ×4 names · signal nature + learning shown
the pipeline that actually runs (OneBrainComposer, on the shared "one brain")
hears words in context, picks up meaning;
similar words end up close together
"cat is chased by dog" · flexible frames
Composer — bind words into a fact
who / what · yes–no & negation · multi–hop reasoning · multi–turn dialogue
answers "I don't know" rather than inventing — a learned familiarity check
reconstruct a stored fact → unbind the roles → clean up → match the question's cue
the safeguard is what keeps it from making facts up
Comprehend the sentence (the parser routes each word's role into the composer) → the composer binds agent + action + patient into a single fact and writes it to the store.
A question reconstructs the matching fact, unbinds the role asked for, and answers — or, if no stored fact matches, the safeguard makes it say "I don't know" instead of guessing.

Refs: 2026-06-18-onebrain-320-scale-production-GO · 2026-06-19-consolidation-attr-multiframe · 2026-06-19-latency-csr-cache-GO (the ~10–20× speedup). ⌂ words–in / words–out are the legitimate I/O boundary.

how a conversation runs, in one paragraph
The production pipeline (top) is what actually converses: a sentence is heard, the learned cortex supplies each word's meaning, the parser works out who–did–what,
the composer binds those roles into a single fact and writes it into synapses, and a question reconstructs and unbinds the stored fact to answer — with the no–confabulation safeguard
making it abstain ("I don't know") whenever no stored fact matches. The reply's word order is produced by a spiking "say–this–first" ranking, not a fixed template.
The region inventory (below) is the earlier builder's full map — language I/O, Wernicke comprehension pools, the ATL semantic store + hub, Broca syntax,
the concept pools, the hippocampus (whose sleep–replay consolidation into cortex is what prevents catastrophic forgetting), and the output naming / articulation / motor.
The grey dashed boxes are the earlier composition attempts that did NOT work — kept in the map for honesty; they are why the production composer uses a fixed binding algebra.

Substrate–wide simplifications: point neurons (no dendrites) · one–step conduction delay · simplified neuron + synapse models · word codes are host–supplied token embeddings. Full list SH–1…SH–14 in the spec.
This is an honest map of the code — accurate to the degree the biology is implemented here, including its reductions and its negative results, not a textbook of neuroanatomy.
Refs: 2026-06-18-onebrain-320-scale-production-GO · the consolidation / latency findings · the .dot source + the extraction spec are the source of truth.
